module: Unit tests of the runtime route registry (parsing of raw Vue routes, transactional validation, source precedence, added/removed/changed diffs, instance isolation). Run with: extensions.testFramework_TestManager:runTestFiles("runtimeRouteRegistry"). Useful as examples of the route format accepted by registerModRoutes.
notes: The testXxx(ctx) functions are run by testFramework_TestManager; the game does not call them in normal use.

testParsesSingleNamedRouteWithVueDefault.desc: A named route gets the Vue defaults (runtime, ui.uiTypes = vue, filter only).

testUnnamedGroupEmitsChildrenButNotItsel.desc: A node without a name produces no route but its children do.

testParsesDeeplyNestedChildren.desc: Children nested over several levels are all parsed.

testArrayRouteNamesShareDefinition.desc: An array `name` creates several routes sharing the same definition.

testMapsUiFieldsFromMeta.desc: The meta fields (uiTypes, infoBar, topBar, uiApps, triggerPause, uiNav...) are carried over into `ui`.

testAppliesAllowlistedLuaRouteOverrides.desc: meta.luaRoute applies only the allowed keys.

testRejectsInvalidLifecycleHook.desc: A lifecycle hook that is not "module.func" is rejected.

testRejectsFunctionLifecycleHook.desc: A hook given as a function (not a string) is rejected.

testRejectsBackTargetAndFallbackTargetTo.desc: Simultaneous backTarget and fallbackTarget are rejected.

testRejectsDuplicateRouteNameWithinSourc.desc: A duplicate route name within a source is rejected.

testRejectsInvalidNameShape.desc: A `name` of invalid type (neither string nor array of strings) is rejected.

testFailedReRegistrationKeepsPreviousSna.desc: An invalid re-registration leaves the previous snapshot intact (transactional).

testNewestSourceWinsWithoutComposition.desc: The most recent source wins for the same name, with no merging.

testReRegistrationRetainsOriginalPrecede.desc: Re-registering a source keeps its priority rank.

testUnregisterThenRegisterCreatesNewPrec.desc: Unregistering then re-registering a source gives it the most recent rank.

testUnregisterRestoresPreviousWinner.desc: Unregistering the winning source restores the definition of the previous source.

testSourceOrderTracksFirstRegistration.desc: getSourceOrder follows the order of first registration.

testReRegistrationRemovesStaleNames.desc: Re-registering a source removes the names that are no longer in the new list.

testRegisterReportsAddedAndChangedDiffs.desc: register returns the correct added and changed lists.

testUnregisterReportsRemovedDiff.desc: unregister returns the correct removed list.

testUnregisterMissingSourceIsNoop.desc: Unregistering an unknown source succeeds with no effect (existed = false).

testEffectiveRoutesAreDeepCopied.desc: getEffectiveRoutes returns deep copies: modifying them does not affect the registry.

testInvalidSourceIdRejected.desc: An empty or non-string sourceId is rejected.
